等级与类型怎么定
  • 严重阻塞交付，或造成数据丢失、安全问题，且没有合理绕行

  • 实现缺陷实现违背文档或公开约定

  • 指引错误指引、示例或注释写错，或彼此矛盾，照做会出错

F3 · 非法用户名以 500 INTERNAL_ERROR 暴露，违背稳定错误契约

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication · @nocobase/app-plugin-users · 原评审：未解决

⌄

app-plugin-authentication 的 create 只对 username 做 trim/lowercase，格式约束来自 better-auth 的 username 插件；app-plugin-users 的 /api/users 错误映射只覆盖 UserAdministrationError 与 PermissionSetLastAssignmentError，未识别的 better-auth APIError 会冒泡为 500。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

users 技能与路由文档承诺可识别的 error.reason 与稳定错误体：重复身份返回 409 ALREADY_EXISTS，其他用户输入问题返回 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

评审时 · 实际观察

实测 POST /api/users 传含连字符的用户名得到 res.status=500、err.type=APIError、err.message="Username is invalid"，未走统一错误体映射。

实际影响
管理员创建含连字符用户名时收到 500 而非可识别的 400/INVALID_ARGUMENT，客户端无法给出字段级提示，也掩盖了“输入非法”这一语义。
建议改法
在 users 路由的错误映射中把 better-auth 校验类 APIError 映射为 INVALID_ARGUMENT（必要时带字段），或在 authentication 侧先做格式校验并抛 UserAdministrationError。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
创建用户时提交 better-auth username 插件所不允许的字符集（如连字符）。
应有能力 / 行为
返回 4xx，reason=INVALID_ARGUMENT，并带可本地化消息。
实际观察
better-auth 的 APIError 未被 users 路由映射，返回 500 INTERNAL_ERROR，err.type=APIError。
应用绕行与代价
调用方改用满足 /^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]{3,30}$/ 的用户名。
改进后的验收标准
新增测试：非法用户名返回 INVALID_ARGUMENT 而非 500。

### [轻微][实现缺陷] 非法用户名以 500 INTERNAL_ERROR 暴露，违背稳定错误契约

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication`（评审时 2.0.0-beta.0）、`@nocobase/app-plugin-users`（评审时 2.0.0-beta.0）

app-plugin-authentication 的 create 只对 username 做 trim/lowercase，格式约束来自 better-auth 的 username 插件；app-plugin-users 的 /api/users 错误映射只覆盖 UserAdministrationError 与 PermissionSetLastAssignmentError，未识别的 better-auth APIError 会冒泡为 500。

**文档 / API 声称**：users 技能与路由文档承诺可识别的 error.reason 与稳定错误体：重复身份返回 409 ALREADY_EXISTS，其他用户输入问题返回 INVALID_ARGUMENT。

**实际观察**：实测 POST /api/users 传含连字符的用户名得到 res.status=500、err.type=APIError、err.message="Username is invalid"，未走统一错误体映射。

**影响**：管理员创建含连字符用户名时收到 500 而非可识别的 400/INVALID_ARGUMENT，客户端无法给出字段级提示，也掩盖了“输入非法”这一语义。

**建议改动**：在 users 路由的错误映射中把 better-auth 校验类 APIError 映射为 INVALID_ARGUMENT（必要时带字段），或在 authentication 侧先做格式校验并抛 UserAdministrationError。

**验收标准**：新增测试：非法用户名返回 INVALID_ARGUMENT 而非 500。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/dist/server/user-administration.js:88–104` — user-administration.js 的 create：username = optionalUsername(input.username)，随后 assertIdentityAvailable({email, username}) 只检查唯一性冲突，再调用 better-auth createUser；这里没有用户名格式校验。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/dist/server/user-administration.js:299–303` — optionalUsername 只做 value?.trim().toLowerCase()，并不校验字符集或长度。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-users/dist/server/routes/index.js:215–232` — app-plugin-users 的 /api/users 错误映射只识别 PermissionSetLastAssignmentError（->FAILED_PRECONDITION/LAST_ASSIGNMENT）与 UserAdministrationError（NOT_FOUND / *_CONFLICT->ALREADY_EXISTS / 其余->INVALID_ARGUMENT）；其他异常（如 better-auth 的 APIError）返回 undefined，继续冒泡为 500。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/dist/server/auth.js:14–19` — auth.js 默认把 better-auth 的 username({ displayUsername: false }) 插件加入 plugins，用户名格式约束来自该插件，其校验失败会抛 better-auth 的 APIError。

F2 · seed 的相对值导入说明符在源码加载路径下缺少文档约束

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/db · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development · 原评审：未解决

⌄

task-loader 用原生动态 import 加载任务模块，不注册 TS 传输器，因此被加载的 seed 源码内 `import x from '…/data.js'`（真实文件是 .ts）不会被重写。nocobase-db 的自包含规则与 migrations.md 只约束“迁移/种子自身内容”，未点明跨文件值导入与说明符规则；`pnpm nocobase db apply` 因注册了 tsx 能通过，测试 harness 则失败，形成两条路径行为不一致。

实际影响
代理与使用者在源码路径下会遇到 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，且错误信息指向一个“看起来存在”的 .js 路径，定位成本高。
建议改法
在 nocobase-db 与 migrations.md 明确：种子数据内联或仅使用会被擦除的 `import type`；不要值导入同级应用模块的 .js 说明符；或在源码加载路径注册与 db apply 一致的传输器。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
seed 源码中出现跨文件值导入，specifier 以 .js 结尾而磁盘上是 .ts。
应有能力 / 行为
文档说明源码加载器不做说明符重写、种子应自包含；或加载器在源码路径注册 TS 传输器。
实际观察
测试 harness 下报 Cannot find module .../it-ticket-demo.js；代理改为内联数据后才通过。
应用绕行与代价
把种子数据内联进每个 seed，跨文件仅保留 import type。
改进后的验收标准
在 nocobase-db/migrations.md 增加一条说明符规则，并用一个源码路径种子测试覆盖。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:129–135E53

nocobase-db 技能的自包含规则：迁移/种子必须在本文件内写清每个表、字段、索引、约束与元数据操作，禁止导入会演化的 Collection 定义、模型、注册表或共享常量。

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm nocobase db redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md:122–133E54

迁移/种子清单章节：源码与编译产物按相同校验和记录迁移历史，构建会为每个编译目录生成 .manifest.json；已标记的 JavaScript 需要清单。

## Compiled migration and seed manifests

The application build generates `.manifest.json` in each compiled migrations and seeds directory after server compilation, path rewriting, and `afterServerBuild` hooks. Keep the manifest generator in the build when customizing it. Plugins generate their own manifests when built; an application must not regenerate manifests for installed dependencies.

TypeScript and compiled JavaScript use the same source checksum for migration history, while the loader separately verifies emitted JavaScript. Marked JavaScript requires its manifest. For a database with old raw JavaScript checksums, first run the compiled representation with matching original output; verified legacy hashes are converted under the task lock. Never edit historical migrations, and never edit the history table by hand, to resolve an upgrade failure.

## Reading runtime configuration

Migration callbacks (`shouldRun`, `up`, `down`) and seed `run` receive a read-only `config` reader: `config.get<string>('users.initialAdmin.username')`. Missing keys return `undefined`; the type parameter is a TypeScript assertion, not runtime validation. Validate required settings when they are needed. Application startup and CLI database commands snapshot configuration through the application accessor’s `raw()` method for each execution plan, including application defaults. Custom get-only readers retain their own lookup semantics and remain live; they do not need to support an empty root key. Direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` callers can pass `runtimeConfig`; standalone database runners accept `config` and default to an empty reader.

Plain configuration objects and arrays are copied using the application's configuration semantics; modifying a returned map does not change subsequent reads. Opaque objects and functions retain their existing configuration-library semantics. Only `get` is exposed. Configuration is not added to checksums or task history; do not log secrets yourself. A later rollback gets the configuration available at rollback time, so keep schema operations and their inverses fixed rather than deriving table or field definitions from mutable settings. Existing migration `parameters` still identify fixed targets, and `configuration` still carries source applicability settings.

F4 · 分配到 authenticated 默认受众的权限集会从直接角色选择器消失，应予说明

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/app-plugin-users · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-users · 原评审：未解决

⌄

permission-set-scope.js 的 directRoleState 会先收集 subject.type='authenticated', id='*' 的分配，再把它们从直接角色候选里过滤掉（仅保留 unrestricted 或未受保护的集合）。users 技能解释了 hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess 的语义，但没有直说这一可见后果。

实际影响
使用者把一个权限集设为“所有登录用户的默认”后，会发现它在 Users 页的直接分配中消失，容易误判为配置丢失。
建议改法
在 users 技能的 hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess 段落补一句：分配到该默认受众的集合不再出现在直接角色选择器，逐人额外授权请另建集合或调整受众。

应有能力 / 行为
界面或文档明确解释该集合为何不在直接角色列表。
实际观察
directRoleState 静默过滤掉该集合，文档未点明。
应用绕行与代价
为逐人授权另建未绑定 authenticated 受众的权限集。

must show a protected assignment but must not add or revoke it. Enforce the
same rule in `replace()` because these flags only control the Client. Set

but all signed-in users also inherit separately configured default access; the

### [轻微][易用性改进] 分配到 authenticated 默认受众的权限集会从直接角色选择器消失，应予说明

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-users`（评审时 2.0.0-beta.0）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-users`

permission-set-scope.js 的 directRoleState 会先收集 subject.type='authenticated', id='*' 的分配，再把它们从直接角色候选里过滤掉（仅保留 unrestricted 或未受保护的集合）。users 技能解释了 hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess 的语义，但没有直说这一可见后果。

**影响**：使用者把一个权限集设为“所有登录用户的默认”后，会发现它在 Users 页的直接分配中消失，容易误判为配置丢失。

**建议改动**：在 users 技能的 hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess 段落补一句：分配到该默认受众的集合不再出现在直接角色选择器，逐人额外授权请另建集合或调整受众。

**验收标准**：技能中出现该可见后果说明，或界面给出内联解释。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-users/dist/server/services/permission-set-scope.js:95–119` — permission-set-scope.js 的 directRoleState：先算出 subject.type==='authenticated' && id==='*' 的默认分配集合，再返回 permissionSets.filter(key 不在默认集合 且 (unrestricted 或未受保护))。因此被分配到 authenticated 默认受众的权限集不会出现在“直接角色”选择器中。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-users/SKILL.md:60–66` — users 技能：受保护分配用 assignable/removable=false 且要在 replace() 里同样强制；hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess:true 表示直接分配之外所有登录用户还继承单独配置的默认访问，页面会解释这一区别而不是把默认当成角色。

实现者过程与运行背景 · 10 个过程问题 / 6 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

修复轮 2：上一轮只留下了一张 itTickets 表和一份服务草稿，应用界面上没有任何报修功能；本轮补齐了路由/服务/页面/本地化/种子数据与权限集，并修掉三个真实缺陷（自带路由贡献上的 use('*') 中间件泄漏、seed 依赖同级模块导致测试 harness 加载失败、完成后 close() 被 beforeClose 挡住不关闭），最后在全新数据库 + 生产构建上跑通了 B01-B05 全部验收步骤。演示账号、权限集与样例工单的凭据都只写在 database/main/seeds/2026092100* 中。

问题 01 · 实现阶段

应用只有首页：迁移建了 itTickets 表，却没有路由、页面、用户和权限集

本任务已处理

工厂验收看到默认空工作台；GET /main/api/itTickets 返回 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND；库里只有 Super Admin 一个用户和内置 member/root 权限集。

原因（实现者自述）
初始实现只落了建表迁移和 server/it-tickets 下的草稿文件，没有把 server/routes、server/providers、client/pages、client/routes.ts、client/locales、database/main/seeds 这些应用自有位置补齐，验收侧看到的是一张孤立的表。
处理方式
按 AGENTS.md“一个功能触及五处”补齐：service + authorization 落在 server/it-tickets/，provider 注册进 server/providers/index.ts（对 authorization token 用 container.has 做守卫），defineApiRoutes 挂 /itTickets（GET 列表、GET 单条、POST 创建、POST start、POST complete），client/routes.ts 声明列表/新建/详情抽屉/完成对话框，两份 locale 补全部文案，seed 建演示账号、员工与处理人权限集和样例工单。
影响 / 代价：修复轮 2 的主要工作量来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 实现阶段

自带路由贡献上的 router.use('*', auth, authz) 泄漏到之后挂载的 /api/* 贡献

本任务已处理

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 的 'starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs' 失败：expected 401 to be 404，未认证访问 /api/articles 从 404 变成 401。

原因（实现者自述）
在 defineApiRoutes 返回的 Hono 实例上直接 use('*')，中间件会作用于随后挂到同一 app 的所有 /api 路径，而不只是本功能拥有的路径。
处理方式
照官方 app-plugin-users 的写法改成隔离子路由：内层 const routes = new Hono()，只在 routes 上 use('*', authentication.required(), authorization.middleware())，再 router.route('/itTickets', routes)；内层路径相应改为 '/'、'/:ticketId'、'/:ticketId/start'、'/:ticketId/complete'。app-server.test.ts 恢复 28/28。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 自动验证

seed import 同级模块时 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND：原生 Node 类型剥离不改写 .js 说明符

本任务已处理

在测试 harness 下加载 seed 直接失败 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND（例如 import { ... } from './permission-sets.js'），而 pnpm nocobase db apply 却能跑通。

原因（实现者自述）
@nocobase/db 的 task-loader importTaskDefinition() 用原生动态 import()：db apply 会先注册 tsx，所以源码目录可用；测试 harness 不注册 tsx，Node 原生类型剥离只删类型、不会把 .js 说明符解析到同目录的 .ts。
处理方式
把数据内联进每个 seed（账号、权限集授予文档、样例工单），删除 database/seed-data/，只保留会被擦除的 import type。三个 seed 自包含后 db apply、app-server.test.ts 与新增的 it-tickets.test.ts 全部通过。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 实现阶段

authz.ui.place 只能指向 subsection，不能指向顶层 section

本任务已处理

pnpm nocobase db apply 在注册授权 UI 放置时报错，应用无法完成初始化。

原因（实现者自述）
授权 UI 的 place() 只接受子节点；business 是顶层 section，不能直接作为放置目标。
处理方式
先用 authz.ui.sections.add({ name: 'business.itTickets', parent: 'business' }) 建子节点，再把复合资源与记录访问规则 place 到 business.itTickets。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 浏览器验收

完成对话框成功提交后不关闭：close() 会先等 beforeClose()

本任务已处理

填写处理说明后点完成，工单已经是 Completed，但对话框留在屏幕上；Playwright 流程卡在 waitForURL。

原因（实现者自述）
beforeClose={() => !submittingRef.current} 在提交进行中返回 false，而 close() 先 await beforeClose() 且只有返回 true 才导航；成功分支里守卫还是 true。
处理方式
成功与 404 分支都先释放提交守卫（onSubmittingChange?.(false)）再 await close()；新建工单对话框的同一顺序也复核过，B01 与 B04 均能正常关闭并回到列表。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 浏览器验收

成功 toast 悬停在抽屉页脚上会暂停消失计时，挡住自动化点击

本任务已处理

点“开始处理”后的成功 toast 正好浮在抽屉页脚，Playwright 悬停在页脚时 toast 不消失并拦截点击。

原因（实现者自述）
toast 的 dismiss 计时在 hover 时暂停，而它的位置压在抽屉底部按钮上。
处理方式
去掉“开始处理”的成功 toast（状态徽章刷新已经给出反馈），完成对话框的 toast 保留。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · 实现阶段

把员工权限集指派给 authenticated:* 会让它从用户页的“添加用户”选择器里消失

本任务已处理

管理员在 /settings/users 添加同事时看不到员工/处理人权限集，无法满足“给新同事安排相同工作权限”。

原因（实现者自述）
users 插件的 directRoleState() 把任何指派给 authenticated:* 的权限集当作默认访问并从可选集合里过滤掉。
处理方式
权限集直接指派给两个演示员工用户与处理人用户（user:<id>:<set>），不再挂 authenticated:*；管理员在新建用户时即可勾选，新增的 it-tickets.test.ts 也用 roleScopes.app 数组走通了“新同事拿到相同权限后能看到自己的空列表并提交工单”。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 08 · 浏览器验收

Better Auth 用户名不允许连字符，非法输入被映射成 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

本任务已处理

POST /main/api/users 用 qa-a-123456 返回 500，服务端日志是 APIError: Username is invalid。

原因（实现者自述）
@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的校验规则是 /^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$/，非法输入没有映射成 INVALID_ARGUMENT，直接冒成 500。
处理方式
验收脚本改用下划线用户名（qa_a_123456）并记录该限制；未改平台代码。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 09 · 实现阶段

ESLint @typescript-eslint/unbound-method：从 context 对象解构方法

本任务已处理

lint 报 unbound-method，位置在 seed 的 async run({ repository }) { ... }。

原因（实现者自述）
从上下文对象解构出方法后单独调用，会丢掉 this。
处理方式
改成 async run(context) 并在 context 上取值调用；query/config 这类数据属性解构不受影响。

问题 10 · 浏览器验收

用 tbody tr 计数做筛选断言不可靠，抽屉内容也要等数据加载

本任务已处理

按状态筛选后 tbody tr 计数为 1，看似有数据实际是空状态行；打开抽屉立刻读文本只得到 'Ticket | Close'。

原因（实现者自述）
空状态同样渲染一个 tbody tr；抽屉容器出现早于记录请求返回。
处理方式
断言改为空状态文案与 /api/itTickets 响应并用 waitForResponse 等筛选请求，抽屉读取前先等描述/未找到文案出现。B05 三个阶段（Pending 排除、Completed 包含、All 包含）因此可重复通过。

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · Skill 与文档

路由贡献的中间件隔离要有正/反两段代码，而不是只有一句规则

可自动化

AGENTS.md 已写“Scope middleware to the exact paths you own”，但示例里的 defineApiRoutes 骨架直接在返回的 router 上写路由；照抄就会写出会泄漏的 use('*')，只有 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 的 404 断言把它抓出来。

建议改动

在 server-routes.md 增加两段对照代码：错误（在贡献 router 上 use('*')）与正确（内层子路由 + router.route(prefix, routes)，并引用 app-plugin-users 的官方写法），并说明内层路径不再重复前缀。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 脚手架默认值

seeds 的“自包含”要求要明确覆盖 import 说明符

可自动化

文档强调 migration 必须自包含，但没有说 seed 不能 import 同级模块：db apply 注册了 tsx 所以本地跑得通，测试 harness 用原生 Node 类型剥离时同目录 .js 说明符不会被解析到 .ts，表现为 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND。

建议改动

在 migrations/seeds 文档补一句“seed 数据内联，禁止 import 同级模块；import type 安全”，或让 task-loader 在未注册 TS 加载器时也注册 tsx，并在 seed 目录加一条只看非 type import 的检查。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · Skill 与文档

overlay 文档要把 close() 与 beforeClose() 的时序写成硬约束

需人工判断

close() 会先 await beforeClose()，只有返回 true 才导航；把“提交中”守卫直接接在 beforeClose 上、成功分支又忘了先释放，就会出现“数据已保存但对话框不关”的复现难度较高的 bug（本轮在完成对话框与新建对话框各核对一次）。

建议改动

在 overlay.md 的完整示例中给 beforeClose 配一行注释“成功路径必须先释放守卫再 await close()”，并把 404/失败分支一并写全。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · 验收机制

把“未认证访问不存在的 /api 路径必须 404”固定为模板级断言

可自动化

这一条断言实际捕获了本轮最严重的回归（中间件泄漏把 404 变成 401），说明它对“应用新增路由贡献”的改动是有效的守护，值得每个应用都保留。

建议改动

在应用测试模板中保留 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 的该用例，并在 testing.md 里把它列为路由贡献类改动的必跑断言。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · 工具与构建

Better Auth 的用户名非法输入应映射为 INVALID_ARGUMENT

可自动化

@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的 username 校验失败会冒成 500 INTERNAL_ERROR 并只写进服务端日志，调用方看到的是“服务器错误”，容易误导排查方向。

建议改动

在 users 路由的输入校验或 auth 适配层把该 APIError 映射成 400/INVALID_ARGUMENT 并返回可读 reason。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · 验收机制

列表筛选验收不要数 tbody tr

可自动化

空状态也渲染一行 tbody tr，计数断言会把“筛选后无数据”判成通过；抽屉类覆盖层的文本也要等记录请求返回后再读。

建议改动

把“断言空状态文案或对应 /api 响应 + waitForResponse”写进 UI 验收的通用约定。

来源：Agent · retro.json

提供的帮助

应保留的能力

So `production: false` → throws on problems. Must be clean. I'll verify by actually running it.\n\nNow let me write everything. Let me start.\n\nActually one more decision: **the page grant for `itTickets`**. The employee permission set includes `page:itTickets.access`. The route declares `authz: { resource: { type: 'page', id: 'itTickets' }, action: 'access' }`. Client-side, the page becomes visible only if the user's grants include it. Employees get it via the employee set (assigned to `authenticated:*`). Handlers get... the handler set also needs the page grant. And root/users with `root` set see everything (unrestricted).\n\nBut what about a brand-new account created by the admin in the Users page — does it get the employee set? My provider assigns `it-ticket-employee` to subject `{type:'authenticated', id:'*'}` once at boot (create-if-missing). Any signed-in user gets `authenticated:*` → the employee set. ✓ \n\nAnd the handler set is assigned to the specific handler demo user.\n\nHmm, but careful: assigning the employee set to `authenticated:*` means **every** user (including a newly invited colleague) automatically gets \"employee\" permissions. Is that acceptable per the review criteria? \"管理员可以为新同事分配相同的工作权限\" (admin can assign the same work permissions to new colleagues). The handler set is the \"same work permissions\" to assign. The employee baseline being automatic is a *reasonable* default (mirrors `member`), but it does mean an admin cannot *remove* employee access from a random user without editing the set. Hmm.\n\nAlternative: assign the employee set per-user at provisioning time (for the two demo employees), and let the admin assign it to new colleagues from the Users page. That's more faithful to \"admin assigns permissions\". But then any QA-created account (via signup fallback) wouldn't be able to submit tickets — the QA harness says \"优先使用需求提供的测试账号，或通过管理员 UI 创建账号并赋予相应角色\" (prefer provided test accounts, or create accounts via admin UI and give the roles). So a QA-created account would need the role assigned; the QA prompt explicitly allows creating accounts via the admin UI *and giving them the appropriate role*. So per-user assignment is acceptable and arguably better.\n\nHmm, but risk: if the QA harness creates an account through the signup page (not admin UI) and doesn't assign a role, they'd see no page. The task requires 2 demo employee accounts to exist, so the harness should use those. But it also might create its own.\n\nSafest: **assign the employee set to `authenticated:*`** so every signed-in user can at least submit and see their own tickets (this is the \"employee\" baseline, matching how `member` works), AND provision the two demo employees plus per-user assignment of the handler set to the demo handler. {"type":"message_start","message":{"role":"toolResult","toolCallId":"call_j8qywyn2","toolName":"bash","content":[{"type":"text","text":"agent-browser snapshot -i\n\n# Pick the email/password refs out of the snapshot, then:\nagent-browser fill @e3 \"user@example.com\"\nagent-browser fill @e4 \"hunter2\"\nagent-browser click @e5\nagent-browser wait --url \"**/dashboard\"\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n```\n\nCredentials in shell history are a leak. For anything sensitive, use the auth vault (see [references/authentication.md](references/authentication.md)):\n\n```bash\nagent-browser auth save my-app --url https://app.example.com/login \\\n  --username user@example.com --password-stdin\n# (type password, Ctrl+D)\n\nagent-browser auth login my-app    # fills + clicks, waits for form\n```\n\nIf credentials live in an external vault, use a configured credential provider plugin instead of putting secrets in the command line:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser plugin add agent-browser-plugin-vault --name vault\nagent-browser plugin list\nagent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item \"My App\"\nagent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item \"My App\" --url https://app.example.com/login --username-selector \"#email\" --password-selector \"#password\"\n```\n\nPlugins can also provide browser providers, launch mutators such as stealth setup, and arbitrary namespaced commands:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --provider cloud-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser plugin run captcha captcha.solve --payload '{\"siteKey\":\"...\",\"url\":\"https://example.com\"}'\n```\n\n`plugin run` is for `command.run` and custom capabilities. Core capabilities and protocol request types use their dedicated command paths.\n\n### Persist session across runs\n\n```bash\n# Derive one stable id for this agent/worktree\nSESSION=\"$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix my-app)\"\n\n# Pass the same id and restore request on every command\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" --restore open https://app.example.com\n```\n\n`--restore` with no value uses the current `--session` as the persistence key. Agent skills should prefer this over hand-built state file paths. Use `--restore-save auto` by default so a failed restore does not overwrite the previous known-good state. State is saved on close and also periodically while the browser is open (at most once per `AGENT_BROWSER_AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS`, default 30000), so state survives even if the user closes the browser window by hand.\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" --restore --restore-check-text Dashboard open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session \"$SESSION\" session info --json\n```\n\n### Extract data\n\n```bash\n# Structured snapshot (best for AI reasoning over page content)\nagent-browser snapshot -i --json > page.json\n\n# Targeted extraction with refs\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser get text @e5\nagent-browser get attr @e10 href\n\n# Arbitrary shape via JavaScript\ncat <<'EOF' | agent-browser eval --stdin\nconst rows = document.querySelectorAll(\"table tbody tr\");\nArray.from(rows).map(r => ({\n  name: r.cells[0].innerText,\n  price: r.cells[1].innerText,\n}));\nEOF\n```\n\nPrefer `eval --stdin` (heredoc) or `eval -b <base64>` for any JS with quotes or special characters. Inline `agent-browser eval \"...\"` works only for simple expressions.\n\n### Screenshot\n\n```bash\nagent-browser screenshot                        # temp path, printed on stdout\nagent-browser screenshot page.png               # specific path\nagent-browser screenshot --full full.png        # full scroll height\nagent-browser screenshot --annotate map.png     # numbered labels + legend keyed to snapshot refs\n```\n\nHeadless Chromium screenshots hide native scrollbars for consistent image output. Pass `--hide-scrollbars false` when launching to keep native scrollbars visible.\n\n`--annotate` is designed for multimodal models: each label `[N]` maps to ref `@eN`.\n\n### Handle multiple pages via tabs\n\n```bash\nagent-browser tab                      # list open tabs (with stable tabId)\nagent-browser tab new https://docs...  # open a new tab (and switch to it)\nagent-browser tab t2                   # switch to tab t2\nagent-browser tab close t2             # close tab t2\n```\n\nStable `tabId`s mean `t2` points at the same tab across commands even when other tabs open or close. After switching, refs from a prior snapshot on a different tab no longer apply — re-snapshot. `tab list --json` also reports each tab's CDP `targetId`, accepted anywhere a tab ref is accepted; target ids stay stable across daemon restarts, unlike `t<N>` ids.\n\nSwitching has two special cases worth knowing:\n\n- **Discarded tab (Chrome Memory Saver).** A backgrounded tab may have its renderer dropped. Switching to it reactivates the tab, which reloads the page and discards unsaved state (form input, scroll position). The switch result then includes `\"revived\": true`, so treat prior in-page state as gone and re-snapshot. Closing the active tab onto a discarded successor reports `\"activeTabRevived\": true` for the same reason.\n- **Tab blocked by a dialog.** If the target tab has an open dialog (`confirm`/`prompt`, or `alert`/`beforeunload` under `--no-auto-dialog`) its renderer is paused, not discarded, so the switch leaves it untouched and reports `\"dialogBlocked\": true`. Resolve the dialog with `dialog accept`/`dialog dismiss` before interacting with the page.\n\n### Run multiple browsers in parallel\n\nEach `--session <name>` is an isolated browser with its own cookies, tabs, and refs. For agent skills, derive stable names with `agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix <skill>`. Useful for testing multi-user flows or parallel scraping:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser --session a open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session b open https://app.example.com\nagent-browser --session a fill @e1 \"alice@test.com\"\nagent-browser --session b fill @e1 \"bob@test.com\"\n```\n\n`AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=myapp` sets the default session for the current shell.\n\nWhen several sessions share one Chrome over `--cdp <port>`, add `--pin-tab` so each session sticks to its own tab. Every session remembers its bound tab across daemon restarts; with `--pin-tab` a command whose bound tab was closed fails with a `tab_gone` error instead of acting on another session's tab. JSON output includes `\"code\": \"tab_gone\"`, `data.targetId`, and an optional sanitized `data.lastUrl` for recovery. Recover with `tab new <url>` or pick a tab from `tab list`. The flag is sticky per session, so pass it once (`--no-pin-tab` turns it off again). See `references/session-management.md` for details.\n\n### Mock network requests\n\n```bash\nagent-browser network route \"**/api/users\" --body '{\"users\":[]}'   # stub a response\nagent-browser network route \"**/analytics\" --abort                 # block entirely\nagent-browser network requests                                     # inspect what fired\nagent-browser network har start                                    # record all traffic\n# ... perform actions ...\nagent-browser network har stop /tmp/trace.har\n\n# HAR files embed text response bodies (JSON/HTML/JS) by default, so the\n# recording alone is enough to study a site's API offline. Use\n# `--content all` to include binary bodies or `--content none` to disable.\n```\n\n### Record a video of the workflow\n\n```bash\nagent-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser record start demo.webm\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser click @e3\nagent-browser record stop\n```\n\nSee [references/video-recording.md](references/video-recording.md) for codec options, GIF export, and more.\n\n### Iframes\n\nIframes are auto-inlined in the snapshot — their refs work transparently:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser snapshot -i\n# @e3 [Iframe] \"payment-frame\"\n#   @e4 [input] \"Card number\"\n#   @e5 [button] \"Pay\"\n\nagent-browser fill @e4 \"4111111111111111\"\nagent-browser click @e5\n```\n\nTo scope a snapshot to an iframe (for focus or deep nesting):\n\n```bash\nagent-browser frame @e3      # switch context to the iframe\nagent-browser snapshot -i\nagent-browser frame main     # back to main frame\n```\n\n### Dialogs\n\n`alert` and `beforeunload` are auto-accepted so agents never block. For `confirm` and `prompt`:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser dialog status          # is there a pending dialog?\nagent-browser dialog accept           # accept\nagent-browser dialog accept \"text\"    # accept with prompt input\nagent-browser dialog dismiss          # cancel\n```\n\n## Diagnosing install issues\n\nIf a command fails unexpectedly (`Unknown command`, `Failed to connect`, stale daemons, version mismatches after `upgrade`, missing Chrome, etc.) run `doctor` before anything else:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser doctor                     # full diagnosis (env, Chrome, daemons, config, providers, network, launch test)\nagent-browser doctor --offline --quick   # fast, local-only\nagent-browser doctor --fix               # also run destructive repairs (reinstall Chrome, purge old state, ...)\nagent-browser doctor --json              # structured output for programmatic consumption\n```\n\n`doctor` auto-cleans stale socket/pid/version sidecar files on every run. Destructive actions require `--fix`. Exit code is `0` if all checks pass (warnings OK), `1` if any fail.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**\"Ref not found\" / \"Element not found: @eN\"** Page changed since the snapshot. Run `agent-browser snapshot -i` again, then use the new refs.\n\n**Element exists in the DOM but not in the snapshot** It's probably off-screen or not yet rendered. Try

应用模板把“有页面和 API 的功能触及五处”写成明确规则：迁移建表、server/routes 路由、client/pages 页面并在 client/routes.ts 声明、导航与本地化字符串。

A page with children or page-local helpers uses a folder with `index.tsx`; child folders mirror route paths. Keep page-local components and data in that folder, reserving `client/components/` for application-wide components. See [child routes](.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/child-routes.md) for examples.

A feature with a page and an API touches five places: a migration for the table, a route in `server/routes/`, a page in `client/pages/` declared in `client/routes.ts`, navigation on the page route, and strings in `client/locales/`.

`client/runtime.ts` composes the browser application; `client/react-providers.ts` declares React providers in outer-to-inner layers `root`, `application`, and `extension`. Applications use the first two and plugins own the last; `before` and `after` order providers only within their layer.

E51 · app/AGENTS.md:105–109

前端路由规则：defineAppRoutes 声明路由与 URL 可寻址的对话框/抽屉子路由，导航在路由上声明；并明确要求实现覆盖层或关闭守卫前先读 overlay.md。

Use `defineSettingsRoutes()` for administrative pages, which mount under `/settings`, and `defineDevRoutes()` for development-only pages, which mount under `/dev` and are absent from a production build. Do not repeat `/settings` or `/dev` in the path. `defineDevRoutes()` is a build boundary, not a permission boundary: a page that must be restricted in production is a settings route with `authz`, enforced by the server.

**Declare navigation on the route.** App, Settings and Dev menus read `navigation: { title: 'navigation.orders' }`; titles resolve in the owning locale namespace. Add the translation in `client/locales/`. Refine resources do not add menu entries.

Use recursive groups to organize menus; their path is optional. Pages may also have children, but must manually render `Outlet`. For URL-addressable dialogs and drawers, declare the child in `defineAppRoutes()` in `client/routes.ts`, place the owning page's `Outlet`, then render `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`. A child page of its own — a record's page, a form too long for a dialog — returns `RouteChildPage` around its `PageContainer`; only tab content renders inline, and a child route that returns a bare `PageContainer` renders below the parent's content instead of covering it. Call `useRouteOverlay()` only from a descendant rendered inside the overlay, including its footer, never from the page returning the wrapper. A record opens over the page the user is on: a dashboard or a board that shows records declares their drawer under its own route instead of linking to the list's, and a row menu's Edit opens its own dialog rather than the one stacked on the drawer. On a page with tabs the user is on the tab being shown: an overlay the page's header opens is declared under every tab and linked through the current tab (`` `${tab}/edit` ``, never a bare `edit`, which resolves beside the tabs), so it stacks on that tab and closing returns to it. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/overlay.md` before implementing overlays or close guards.

E53 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:129–135

nocobase-db 技能的自包含规则：迁移/种子必须在本文件内写清每个表、字段、索引、约束与元数据操作，禁止导入会演化的 Collection 定义、模型、注册表或共享常量。

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm nocobase db redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

E54 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md:122–133

迁移/种子清单章节：源码与编译产物按相同校验和记录迁移历史，构建会为每个编译目录生成 .manifest.json；已标记的 JavaScript 需要清单。

## Compiled migration and seed manifests

The application build generates `.manifest.json` in each compiled migrations and seeds directory after server compilation, path rewriting, and `afterServerBuild` hooks. Keep the manifest generator in the build when customizing it. Plugins generate their own manifests when built; an application must not regenerate manifests for installed dependencies.

TypeScript and compiled JavaScript use the same source checksum for migration history, while the loader separately verifies emitted JavaScript. Marked JavaScript requires its manifest. For a database with old raw JavaScript checksums, first run the compiled representation with matching original output; verified legacy hashes are converted under the task lock. Never edit historical migrations, and never edit the history table by hand, to resolve an upgrade failure.

## Reading runtime configuration

Migration callbacks (`shouldRun`, `up`, `down`) and seed `run` receive a read-only `config` reader: `config.get<string>('users.initialAdmin.username')`. Missing keys return `undefined`; the type parameter is a TypeScript assertion, not runtime validation. Validate required settings when they are needed. Application startup and CLI database commands snapshot configuration through the application accessor’s `raw()` method for each execution plan, including application defaults. Custom get-only readers retain their own lookup semantics and remain live; they do not need to support an empty root key. Direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` callers can pass `runtimeConfig`; standalone database runners accept `config` and default to an empty reader.

Plain configuration objects and arrays are copied using the application's configuration semantics; modifying a returned map does not change subsequent reads. Opaque objects and functions retain their existing configuration-library semantics. Only `get` is exposed. Configuration is not added to checksums or task history; do not log secrets yourself. A later rollback gets the configuration available at rollback time, so keep schema operations and their inverses fixed rather than deriving table or field definitions from mutable settings. Existing migration `parameters` still identify fixed targets, and `configuration` still carries source applicability settings.

E55 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:175–177

server-routes.md 的显式警告：把中间件限定在自己拥有的路径，或用挂载在自身前缀下的隔离子路由；顶层 router.use('*', ...) 会泄漏到之后挂载的贡献，使无关端点被误保护或自身端点被漏保护。

## Scope middleware to paths you own

Use the explicit path, or an isolated sub-router mounted at your prefix as above. A `router.use('*', ...)` on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later and is the way an unrelated endpoint accidentally becomes protected — or, worse, the way yours accidentally is not.

E56 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:95–135

server-routes.md 的授权路由示例：在 defineApiRoutes 内先 new Hono() 作为返回的贡献路由器，再用 const routes = new Hono<AuthorizationEnv>() 承载业务路径，最后 router.route('/orderAdmin', routes) 挂载，从而把中间件作用域与贡献隔离。

export const orderAdminRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> =
  defineApiRoutes((app) => {
    const router = new Hono();
    const routes = new Hono<AuthorizationEnv>();
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const authorization = app.container.resolve(authorizationToken);

    routes.use('*', auth.required(), authorization.middleware());
    routes.get(
      '/',
      describeRoute({
        tags: ['Orders'],
        summary: 'List orders for administration',
        operationId: 'listAdministeredOrders',
        responses: {
          '200': listResponse(OrderSchema),
          // 401, 403 and 500: authenticated, with a permission check. No validator, so no 400.
          ...apiErrorResponses,
        },
      }),
      async (context) => {
        const allowed = await context.get('authz').can({
          resource: { type: 'settings', id: 'orders-admin' },
          action: 'read',
        });
        if (!allowed) {
          throw new ApiError({
            status: 'PERMISSION_DENIED',
            reason: 'ORDERS_ADMIN_DENIED',
            domain: 'orders',
            message: 'Reading the order administration is not allowed.',
          });
        }

        const { rows, total } = await listOrders();
        return context.json({ data: rows, meta: { total } });
      },
    );

    router.route('/orderAdmin', routes);

E57 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/overlay.md:155–162

overlay.md 2.5 节把关闭守卫讲清楚：beforeClose 读 ref 而非 state，提交中返回 false 保持覆盖层打开；state+ref 在同一 handleSubmittingChange 中同步更新，成功保存后必须先释放守卫再 close()。

- `beforeClose` applies to the top-right button, Esc, clicking the backdrop and `close()`; **browser back and forward do not go through it**.
- Returning `false` (or a Promise that resolves to `false`) keeps the overlay open.

**No closing while submitting** (guideline T3.5): write `beforeClose={() => !submittingRef.current}`, using both a state and a ref:

- The state (`submitting`) renders the buttons' disabled and loading states; the ref (`submittingRef`) is what `beforeClose` reads. Both are updated together in the same `handleSubmittingChange` (see `new.tsx`, [`example/create-dialog.md`](example/create-dialog.md)).
- Using only the state, as `() => !submitting`, is unreliable: state updates only on the next render, so a `close()` called right after a successful save may run the `beforeClose` from the "submitting" render, read `submitting === true`, and have the close blocked.
- On success, `ProjectForm` guarantees that it passes `onSubmittingChange(false)` before calling `onSubmitted`, so calling `close()` directly in `onSubmitted` closes the overlay.

E58 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:58–69

授权技能：用 defineDatabasePermission 声明集合权限、defineCompositeResource 组合业务操作，provider boot 时用 authz.database.collections.add / compositeResources.define / recordAccess.define / settings.add 注册，再用 authz.ui.sections.add 与 authz.ui.place 放入权限工作区；路由用 authorizeRepository 或 authz.middleware()+withPolicy 绑定策略。

2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.

IT 报修服务从授权决策取出 database 策略并交给 repository.withPolicy(policy)；状态流转用 filter.status.eq 的条件更新把“未匹配行”翻译成受控状态错误。

  const decision = await authz.authorize({
    resource: { type: 'composite', id: IT_TICKETS_PAGE_ID },
    action,
  });
  if (decision.effect === 'deny') {
    throw new AuthorizationDeniedError(decision);
  }
  const policy = decision.conditions?.database?.[IT_TICKETS_COLLECTION];
  if (!policy) {
    throw new AuthorizationDeniedError(decision);
  }
  // The policy is stored as a plain object in the decision; it is already the
  // framework's policy for this Collection, so no re-shaping is needed here.
  return policy;
}

export interface CreateItTicketsServiceOptions {
  readonly database: DatabaseManager;
}

export function createItTicketsService({
  database,
}: CreateItTicketsServiceOptions): ItTicketsService {
  const repositoryFor = (
    policy: RepositoryPolicy<ItTicketRow>,
  ): ItTicketRepository =>
    database
      .repository<ItTicketRow>(IT_TICKETS_COLLECTION)
      .withPolicy(policy) as unknown as ItTicketRepository;

  const byId = (id: string) => (filter: FilterBuilder<ItTicketRow>) =>
    filter.string('id').eq(id);

  const byIdInStatus =
    (id: string, status: ItTicketStatus) =>
    (filter: FilterBuilder<ItTicketRow>) =>
      filter.and([
        filter.string('id').eq(id),
        filter.string('status').eq(status),
      ]);
